verdict.rationale: Adyen documents managed payout schedules that can be applied to balance accounts, plus custom payouts that give the platform full control over timing. Marketing copy adds custom payout times and points to CashOut for instant access to funds. However, the evidence never names daily, weekly, or monthly cadences, and instant payouts appear only as a one-line product page mention with no detail on cards or real-time rails. Missing for 10: explicit daily/weekly/monthly/manual schedule options, clear per-seller schedule configuration (schedules are applied to balance accounts grouped by location and currency), documented instant payouts to cards or real-time rails, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
